| description = A basic newbie mob found in various zones.

Giant Rats are a reasonable target for the level 4 to 6 player. Their pelts and fur are useful for some newbie quests in places like [[Qeynos]] and [[Kaladim]]. Their ears can also be used in some cooking recipes. Rats con indifferent and are not aggressive.
